overall_goal: Add hibiscus flowers, chopped ginger, and water to a saucepan

goals.rationale: The person gets a piece of ginger from a bag, breaks it, and places it on the scale to measure it.

goals.description: Rinse the saucepan and fill it with water
goals.rationale: The person washes the saucepan in the sink, fills it with tap water, and places it on the stove burner.

goals.description: Open the hibiscus flower package and weigh the flowers
goals.rationale: The person struggles to open the hibiscus package, uses a knife to cut it open, and then places the flowers on the scale.

goals.description: Clear the scale and re-weigh the hibiscus flowers
goals.rationale: The person removes the ginger and flowers from the scale, sets the ginger aside, and places the hibiscus flowers back onto the scale.

goals.description: Prepare the cutting board and knife
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a knife, washes it, and sets up a chopping board on the counter.

goals.description: Add the weighed hibiscus flowers to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person scoops up the hibiscus flowers from the scale and counter and places them into the saucepan.

goals.description: Wash, chop, and add the ginger to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person takes the ginger to the sink to wash it, brings it back to the chopping board to slice it, and then adds the chopped pieces to the saucepan.

goals.description: Add additional hibiscus flowers from a plastic bag
goals.rationale: The person opens another plastic bag of hibiscus flowers and adds some directly into the pan.

goals.description: Add a second batch of water to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person carries the saucepan back to the sink to fill it with more water.

goals.description: Add a third batch of water to the saucepan
goals.rationale: The person takes the saucepan to the sink once more to add additional water before returning it to the hob.
